messages:
celia: quick heads-up 1 found a handful of console/obsv examples failing in preview. looks like a combination of 1) dashboard heatmap palette rename, 2) latency bucketing API change (`latency_buckets` -> `latency_ranges`), and 3) a couple of dead links to old CDN assets. putting a mini-sweep on the backlog.

omar: ugh. did the renderer throw errors or just visual glitches?

celia: renderer error for the heatmap samples (throws: `UnknownPaletteError: palette 'coolwarm' not found`). latency examples render but charts show empty series because key renamed.

prasanna: can you paste a minimal repro for the latency rename? I can patch snippets.

celia: sure. snippet currently in examples/console/dashboards/latency-quickstart.md:```json
{
  "route": "/generate",
  "latency_buckets": [0, 100, 300, 1000]
}
```
should be:```json
{
  "route": "/generate",
  "latency_ranges": [0, 100, 300, 1000]
}
```

tia: thanks. we should add a short migration checklist in the docs landing page and add a compat note to the SDK snippets (js/python) so users searching examples don't get confused.

omar: I'll take the heatmap palette fix + CDN link updates. low risk. will open a PR and run the preview job.

prasanna: I'll do the latency rename across examples and update the quickstart snippets. thinking to include a tiny shim in the examples repo that shows both names for readability:```js
// compat shim for examples
const config = opts.latency_ranges || opts.latency_buckets;
renderHeatmap(config);
```

celia: looks good. docs-bot: can you scan examples/ for occurrences of `latency_buckets` and the old palette names?

.docs-bot: automated scan results: 24 files reference `latency_buckets`; 8 files reference palette `coolwarm`; 5 links to old-cdn.redwood.ai. No credentials found.

omar: plan: I'll open PR 1 for heatmap+links, prasanna opens PR 2 for latency rename + shim + migration note. target: PR1 in next 4 hours, PR2 by EOD.

tia: add a CI linter to `docs-ci` that flags remaining `latency_buckets` in examples/ so we don't regress. also add a small unit in preview job to `render:examples` so the renderer will fail fast if palettes missing.

prasanna: good call. i'll add `rg "latency_buckets" -n examples/ || true` to the lint step and make it fail when count > 0. will include the command in PR description.

celia: PR links when ready and i'll sanity-check preview screenshots. also, please update the CHANGELOG fragment under `docs/CHANGELOG.md` with a short line so PMs can call it out.

omar: opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8240 (heatmap + linkfix). cc @tia for UX review.

prasanna: drafting PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8241 (latency rename + compat shim + migration note). added CI lint and unit preview step.

.docs-bot: PR scan: PR 8240 touches 12 files, includes link updates and palette map. PR 8241 touches 18 files, adds migration note and lint rule. Both PRs clean on basic tests.

tia: quick UX nit on 8240  the updated palette names table could use a short example image for `viridis` vs `plasma`. can you attach a small screenshot in the PR?

omar: adding images now. small size to keep bundle light.

prasanna: once both PRs merge we should kick the docs-preview pipeline and verify no remaining `UnknownPaletteError` in logs. I'll follow up with a short PR that adds a tiny regression test harness that loads all dashboard examples headlessly.

celia: thanks team. timeline looks good. follow-up ticket for tests please (label: docs observability tests).

prasanna: created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4332 - title: "Add headless rendering tests for console dashboard examples".

celia: great. merging plan: merge 8240 first, then rebase 8241, run preview, then merge. I'll monitor. :rocket:
